result:
Turbonomic can help Unilever leverage AI for multi-cloud observability by providing a unified platform that automatically analyzes and optimizes application performance across different cloud environments. It uses AI to identify bottlenecks, predict potential issues, and recommend actions to improve performance and efficiency.

The main difference between Turbonomic and native tools from GCP, AWS, and Azure is that Turbonomic provides a single, unified view and set of recommendations across all clouds, whereas native tools are specific to their respective platforms. Turbonomic's AI-driven approach also allows for more proactive and automated optimization, as it can automatically adjust resources and configurations based on real-time performance data.
